needs_human.note: all_texts=True applies to every PDF page, and pdfminer 'all_texts' also runs layout analysis on text inside figures. Horizontal figure text on a predominantly vertical page now enters the complete page text. The I10 revision allows this, but the effect on pages with chart or diagram labels was not measured.; On a predominantly vertical page, box.get_text() of figure text boxes is joined in layout order, so figure text order relative to body text is not specified.
